name: The common right of toads and men
title: Weapon X #3
desc: Weapon x embarks on an expedition to Wundagore Mountain, former Magneto´s sanctuary, after several years of no returning. In his path is attacked by two Techno-organic Reavers -Dead-eye and Mangle- but he destroyed them. He arrives to the ruins of Wundagore, home of Gateway, an hermit mutant with teleporting powers, who is secured by Carol Danvers his own bodyguard. They are ambushed by Reavers -Donald Pierce and Vultura- from the air. Weapon X, Gateway and Danvers teleport to Reaver´s plane, later Danvers jumps with Pierce out of the plane, in mid air she blows up a granade sacrificing her trying to kill Pierce.
